editorial:
Get ready for a wild ride with Stuart, Kevin, and Bob, three little yellow guys who just want to serve the biggest, baddest boss around. When they meet Scarlet Overkill, a stylish super-villain with big dreams, their simple plan turns into a crazy adventure full of laughs, gadgets, and silly mistakes. The movie keeps things bright, fast, and playful, so you never feel bored. It is packed with goofy humor, colorful scenes, and a fun energy that works great for kids and adults who want something light. You will smile at the silly voices, the wild chases, and the way these tiny troublemakers stumble into huge problems without ever losing their charm.

The animation looks sharp and lively, and the action moves quickly from one funny moment to the next. Scarlet and Herb add extra personality, giving the story a fun villain team to follow. Some jokes land better than others, and the plot can feel a little thin, but the heart and humor carry it. If you want an easy, cheerful watch, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for family movie night.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Scarlet tries to take over the world, but Stuart, Kevin, and Bob accidentally ruin her plan with their usual chaos. Scarlet and Herb are defeated, and the minions end up in London. There, they discover a young Gru, who impresses them with his villain skills. The minions choose Gru as their new boss, setting up their future adventures. The twist is that their search for a leader finally ends with the villain they were always meant to serve.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silly family comedies and colorful animated adventures.
